title: psiadia angustifolia subsp. linearis
intro: Psiadia angustifolia subsp. linearis, commonly known as the Narrow-leaved Psiadia, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family, native to the island of Réunion in the Indian Ocean. Research has shown that this plant has various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Psiadia angustifolia subsp. linearis include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities, suggesting potential applications in wound healing and the treatment of fungal infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
